hypothesis: H-C08-4: for quadratic Pisot base sequences, if the conjugate root beta is positive the set of associative shifts is upward-closed; non-monotone sets occur only when beta < 0 (the factor beta^s flips the sign of the conjugate of the product and the conjugate window is asymmetric).
methodology: Classify each sequence by the sign of beta; compute the associative-shift set; check upward-closure.
question: Why is the set of associative shifts sometimes not upward-closed (e.g. s = 2 and s >= 4 but not 3)?
